objective: preserve the prewarmed static-cache speed for single-image discovery while preventing compiled static-cache failure during multi-image Agent review

failure_reproduction.mode: read-only direct candidate generation with one original image plus two review images
failure_reproduction.exception: AssertionError in torch._inductor.cudagraph_trees.get_obj while compiling a new multi-image static-cache shape
failure_reproduction.interpretation: Single-image discovery acceptance did not exercise the later multi-image Agent review shape. The user could therefore see candidates generated quickly but wait more than a minute before failure.

accepted_change.policy: Select the stable dynamic cache before generation whenever a static-configured request contains anything other than one image; retain the prewarmed static path for one-image discovery.
accepted_change.trace_visibility: Configured cache, effective cache, and bounded fallback reason are retained in request-bound inference statistics.

verification.fast_5090_route: disabled because non-owned pqr3d workloads currently keep both GPUs at 98 percent utilization

limits: The 79.97 percent wall-time reduction is one same-input engineering reproduction against a failing compiled path, not a population latency benchmark.
Dynamic cache is deliberately used for multi-image review stability; further multi-image speed work must not re-enable unprewarmed CUDA-graph variants on Flask worker threads.
The 5090 fast route remains disabled until non-owned workloads release the GPUs; no external process was stopped or modified.
